assignments.essential_function: Research prospect accounts and contacts, check existing ownership, assess ICP fit and identify sourced outreach hooks.

review: Full source provides company/contact research, CRM ownership/deduplication check, dated public signals, evidence-backed ICP fit and sourced outreach hooks. It labels inferred priorities and unverified dimensions and works from uploads when enrichment is absent. Read-only research; no contact creation or messages. Qualitative fit is a prospecting judgment, not an objective purchase-propensity score.
native_prerequisites: Target company/domain and the seller's ICP, value proposition and proof points
Web search or enrichment for current public facts; CRM or uploaded account book for ownership/deduplication
Native sales context and optional CONNECTORS.md category bindings; no prompt edit required
